join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a test."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit 1 "This is a testerino."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 edited.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a testerino."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote edit <index> <quote>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote edit <index> <quote>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit 2 "foobar"
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2 does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote edit 1 something
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote edit 1 something
no_send
